expectations.text: waybar style.css applies background-color and border-radius to individual module selectors (#clock, #battery, #network, etc.) rather than only to .modules-left/.modules-center/.modules-right
expectations.evidence: style.css lines 20-32: individual selectors #workspaces, #clock, #battery, #backlight, #network, #bluetooth, #pulseaudio each receive background-color: rgba(26, 27, 38, 0.85) and border-radius: 20px. No .modules-left/.modules-center/.modules-right selectors are used for pill styling.

expectations.text: waybar config includes a battery module with states (warning and/or critical thresholds)
waybar config includes a backlight module
expectations.evidence: config.jsonc includes a "backlight" module in modules-right and a full backlight configuration block with format and format-icons

expectations.text: waybar config includes a bluetooth module
expectations.evidence: config.jsonc includes "bluetooth" in modules-right with full configuration: format, format-connected, format-connected-battery, tooltip formats, and on-click action

expectations.text: style.css uses Tokyo Night colors (e.g. #1a1b26, #a9b1d6, #7aa2f7, #bb9af7, #9ece6a, or similar)
expectations.evidence: style.css uses canonical Tokyo Night palette colors throughout: #1a1b26 (bg), #c0caf5 (fg), #7aa2f7 (blue), #bb9af7 (purple), #9ece6a (green), #414868 (border), #f7768e (red), #7dcfff (cyan), #e0af68 (yellow), #545c7e (comment), #565f89 (dark fg)

expectations.text: monitors.conf or hyprland.conf includes correct monitor lines for eDP-1 (1920x1080@60) and DP-1 (2560x1440@165) with DP-1 to the right
expectations.evidence: hyprland.conf lines 10-11: "monitor = eDP-1, 1920x1080@60, 0x0, 1" and "monitor = DP-1, 2560x1440@165, 1920x0, 1". DP-1 positioned at x=1920 (right edge of eDP-1's 1920px width), correctly placing it to the right.

expectations.text: waybar network module format includes signal strength ({signalStrength}) for wifi
expectations.evidence: config.jsonc network module: "format-wifi": "  {signalStrength}%" — includes {signalStrength} in the wifi format string

claims.claim: Tokyo Night theme is applied consistently across all config files
claims.evidence: hyprland.conf uses rgb(7aa2f7), rgb(bb9af7), rgb(414868) for borders; waybar style.css uses the same palette consistently; all colors map to the Tokyo Night Storm variant

claims.claim: Individual pill/capsule module styling is used
claims.evidence: window#waybar background is transparent, each module selector gets its own background-color, border, and border-radius creating independent pill shapes with 3px margin between them

claims.claim: Laptop-appropriate features are included (touchpad, gestures, brightness keys)
claims.evidence: hyprland.conf includes touchpad natural_scroll, workspace_swipe gestures, and XF86MonoBrightness keybinds — all laptop-relevant features

suggestions.assertion: waybar style.css applies background-color and border-radius to individual module selectors (#clock, #battery, #network, etc.) rather than only to .modules-left/.modules-center/.modules-right
suggestions.reason: This assertion would also pass if modules are styled in a single combined selector rule (as they are here). It doesn't distinguish between truly individual per-module styling vs. a single rule targeting all modules identically. A stricter version could check that at least some modules have distinct background colors or border styles.

eval_feedback.overall: Assertions are well-targeted and cover the key requirements. The one weakness is that the 'individual module selectors' assertion can be satisfied by a single combined selector that applies identical styling to all modules — which is arguably still individual-pill styling, but worth noting.
